name_story.story: Iran can be understood through the Persian form إِيرَان, whose central sense is iran; the land of the aryans (persian). Iran is Persian ایران (Īrān), the name of the country, used as a female given name.

faq.a: Iran is associated with the Persian form إِيرَان, whose core sense is iran; the land of the aryans (persian).

faq.q: What is the origin of Iran?
faq.a: Iran is associated with Persian. Iran is Persian ایران (Īrān), the name of the country, used as a female given name.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Iran can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Iran should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Īrān is a Persian place name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.a: In Urdu, Iran is rendered ایران and carries the sense ایران، ایران.

faq.q: What does Iran mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Iran is rendered ایران and carries the sense ایران، ایران.
A romanized syllable approximation is i-ran. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Iran?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Iran, iran. Script forms are إِيرَان, ايران, ایران, ईरान.

faq.q: Is Iran a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
